name: The Dream Of a Doll
source:
Mansion at night. Countless butterflies. Butterfly tattoo. Mad doctor. Greedy millionaire. A ruthless person. A quiet maid. And the thread of the trap entwined by the vampire Kyle. A long night begins where one thought intersects - "You will definitely kill me".

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-july-2007-bullet-butlers.html]vndbreview[/url]]
